parsed.rationale: Both `QualityTrend` and `ThermalDirection` are `type-alias-union` declarations in the same file (`Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Throttling/QualitySignal.swift`, lines 191 and 208) within the `Wallpaper` package. Although the structural analysis reports `shared_field_count: 3` — meaning both aliases happen to union the same three underlying cases — the two names encode distinct domain concepts: one describes a trend in rendering quality, the other describes a direction of thermal state change. Their structural coincidence is an artifact of the thermal and quality subsystems sharing a small, finite set of directional states (e.g., `up`, `down`, `stable`), not evidence of unintended duplication. Merging or aliasing them to each other would conflate unrelated semantic domains and harm readability.
